scores.evidence: LightGBM handles missing values natively; tested in M2
scores.rationale: Claims about Redis Lua atomicity, hash tags, ISO 8583 response codes, chargeback reason codes, ONNX parity and PCI masking are all accurate, with real limits (e.g. Kafka buffer drops) stated honestly.

scores.evidence: It scores every card authorisation *before* the issuer approves or declines it
scores.rationale: Solves the actual inline real-time problem, resolves ambiguity (issuer assumption flagged as the top question), explicitly scopes non-goals with reasons, and is buildable by the stated team.

scores.evidence: `att:*` (attempts) is written only by the Scoring Service. `appr:*` ... only by the Outcome Consumer
scores.rationale: Single-writer data ownership, consistent identity (txn_id/decision_id) and degraded-flag propagation are applied uniformly across flows with no contradictions found.

scores.evidence: nightly replay of a 0.1% sample against logged vectors (≥ 99.9% match)
scores.rationale: Spikes de-risk latency, labels and the Auth Host contract before commitment; parity, backtest, load and out-of-time evaluation gates have checkable criteria and continue in production via shadow, PSI and reconciliation.

scores.evidence: I picked a sensible default for each gap and labelled it **[A#]**
scores.rationale: Every load, team, stack and compliance assumption is explicit with impact-if-wrong and a validation owner/date, plus the five questions that would most change the design.

scores.evidence: Retried request (same `txn_id`): the duplicate marker is already set, so counters don't change
scores.rationale: Covers Redis failover, Kafka loss, duplicates, bad rule/model mass declines, hot keys, insider allow-listing, model poisoning and label bias with concrete detection and recovery; the reversal gap is an explicit, triggered shortcut.

scores.evidence: Each kill-switch runbook is rehearsed once in a game day during M3
scores.rationale: Named ownership split, paging thresholds tied to domain signals (fallback rate, decline band, degraded rate), 60-second rollback paths for mode, rules, model and code, all sized to the stated team.

Run costs are itemized and grounded with controls and a budget alert, and scaling sensitivity is noted, but the buy-versus-build trade-off against vendor fraud platforms is left as an open question without cost reasoning.

scores.evidence: Point of no return: ending the old system's licence or removing its integration. Don't do this until 8 weeks after switchover
scores.rationale: Every key decision has a reversibility rating and revisit trigger; the hard ones (Auth Host contract, Feature Library, token-only) get early spikes while reversible ones are decided quickly.
Deliberately avoids Flink, a feature-store product, a model server and multi-region, each with a stated trigger to add it later; essentials are not cut.

scores.evidence: *Changes plan if:* budget < 30 ms (in-process library instead of service)
scores.rationale: T1–T17 have concrete done-when criteria, dependency-justified ordering, day-1 critical-path actions, and explicit adaptation conditions if spikes disappoint.

checklist.evidence: Server-side p99 ≤ 30 ms at 1,500 TPS sustained ... per-stage budget (p99)
If the service times out, the Auth Host applies its own **fallback rules**
One Feature Library (JVM) is used both for live scoring and for offline replay
Labels arrive 1–120 days late ... Train on months 1–9 and test on months 10–12 (labels at least 90 days mature)
fraud caught by value, and by count, at fixed decline and review rates ... precision-recall curve
Rules live in Git as small expression-language (CEL) bundles ... hot-loaded ... APPROVE / DECLINE / REVIEW
REVIEW decisions feed the existing case-management tool ... analyst outcomes to `label ∈ {fraud, not_fraud}`
No full card number, CVV, track data, name or address enters the platform
a duplicate `txn_id` doesn't change counters and the second call returns the cached decision
score distribution and population stability index (PSI) ... promoted through shadow, canary and champion
100% of decisions logged with inputs, rule and model versions, and reason codes. Kept 5 years
designed for 1,500 sustained and 3,000 burst ... Minimum 6 pods across 3 availability zones

traps.evidence: Auth Host client timeout of **60 ms** with fallback
out-of-time evaluation set ... labels at least 90 days mature
the same event sequence through the live path ... and the Replay Harness must give identical vectors
Tokens only, no full card numbers ... Shrinks PCI scope

note: An exemplary plan: inline scoring with a safe fallback, shared feature library, honest assumptions and a de-risked build order; the only nameable weakness is thin buy-vs-build cost analysis.
